agent_data_note: Construct the CVE-based C patch porting dataset by collecting CVE patches from NVD/GitHub following the four-step process described in the task brief. Store under `dataset_candidate/cve_patches/`. Do NOT use synthetic or toy patch pairs as the evaluation corpus.
benchmark_rules: Construct the dataset from public NVD CVE records and GitHub commits via the four-step process: (1) collect CVE patches for C projects, (2) expand with additional commits matching edit distance or commit messages, (3) filter to function-level changes and pair earliest vs. latest patches per CVE, (4) split temporally (before/after 2023-08-23) into fine-tuning and evaluation sets.
Store the constructed dataset under `dataset_candidate/cve_patches/` inside the container workspace.
Evaluation must use the temporally-split evaluation set (after 2023-08-23); do not mix fine-tuning data into evaluation.
Report Exactly Match (E-M), Success (Succ), Failure (Fail), and Code BLEU (C-B) at both function level and CVE level.
Compare against at least one baseline: GPT-3.5 / GPT-4o (zero-shot), FixMorph (if installable), or TSBPORT (if installable).
The ground-truth target fix is strictly for evaluation only; do not include it in the model input.
Due to scale constraints, a smaller subset of CVEs (e.g., 50-200 CVEs) is acceptable; document the subset clearly.
Fine-tuning with LoRA requires a GPU with >=48GB VRAM (A100); if GPU is unavailable, evaluate using zero-shot LLM baselines only.
non_goals: Using author-provided private dataset without constructing from public sources
Claiming full reproduction without constructing the dataset per the described protocol
Evaluating on the fine-tuning split (temporal leakage)

construction_steps: 1. Query NVD API for CVE entries referencing GitHub C project commits
2. Expand commit set using edit distance or commit message heuristics
3. Manually (or heuristically) filter to function-level changes; pair earliest vs. latest patch per CVE
4. Split by commit date: before 2023-08-23 (fine-tuning), after (evaluation)
